_rotation: Seconds each window stays on screen before the deck advances. 4 is the testing value; 20 to 30 is right for a wall.
_transition: How long one window takes to slide out and the next to slide in.
_refresh: How often the backend is re-read, on a worker thread. A screen nobody touches can afford to be a minute behind.
_vat_rows: How many vats the league table lists. More than this will not be readable across a room.
